caveats: zones.json is an empty FeatureCollection: no publicly disclosed cat-bond coverage regions were verified from a primary public source. No zones were invented or filled from memory.
Because there are no public zones, every event status is 'no overlap'.
'threshold met' is never assigned without a stated public basis; Phase 1 has no such public criterion, so this status is not used.
Public site files contain no PCS/PERILS or broker data, no deal terms, and no loss estimates. PAGER economic/fatality distributions and empirical dollar figures are excluded from the public site.

PAGER alert level is the USGS overall colour (the higher of the fatality and economic alerts) as published on the event; it is not an insured-loss figure and not a contract result. It is provided so a consumer can colour a map.
Magnitudes, locations, depths and PAGER levels can be revised by USGS. This file is a snapshot at generated_at_utc.
The verified bond watchlist is empty (no verified deal documents). Private contract tests are not represented on this public site.
This snapshot was produced by a one-shot `run` (or `site`) command. No routine or polling service is installed.
Times are converted from the USGS epoch-millisecond origin to UTC and Europe/Zurich (CET/CEST).
ALERT band is M > 6.0 (strictly greater). WATCH band is 5.8 ≤ M ≤ 6.0. Events below M 5.8 are not included.
